name: Campillo de Azaba (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly by three wavy bands, two blue and one white, green at the lower hoist and red at the upper fly.
history: The municipal flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of three wavy diagonal stripes from the upper hoist corner to the lower fly, two blue and a central white one, the hoist part green and the fly part red.

features.role: two blue wavy bands along the division
white wavy band between the blue
